extracted.name: Cornbread Mix
extracted.description: Have you ever seen a recipe that called for something you never heard of, or cannot get. Here is one that is sometimes hard to find and isn't as popular as it used to be. As folks come to your area old things can get lost and new things introduced. As generations pass so does some of the old ways of cooking, " new and improved" ways. The more impossible substitute, and genetically modified organisms we put into our bodies the more modified organisms we become. We are what we eat. We have to eat. As long as I still have a choice I want to enjoy what I eat. I want to eat my comfort food I remember eating long ago.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup all-purpose flour more for dusting
instruction_lines: Gather your dry ingredients and add to a bowl. Add in the lard.
Take your hands and crush the lard into the mixture. Mix well till it looks like sand. This is ready to use. If you don't use put into a Ziploc bag, seal and freeze. I hope you enjoy!!!
